  • Where misses go (the story view): a hit is a small grey dot, a miss is painted in the colour of the type it landed in. A confusion cell is therefore a set of coloured points; if they sit in one territory the two types overlap there, if they sit in one patient it is that patient.
  • Hit rate: white never placed in its type, black always; in the leave-one-out source it has as many steps as refit seeds, in the halves source it is the share of the splits that held the electrode out.
  • Type is the published map, patient colours by patient; use them to check what a pattern in the first two views is made of.
